component.name: TurboCAT 4
component.summary: Catalogue, search and repair Amiga disk images

description.p: TurboCAT 4 catalogues your Amiga disk images, archives and folders: what is on every disk, which are games, which have problems or duplicates, their pictures and their music.

It repairs damaged disks from copies in your own collection, plays disks in Amiberry or FS-UAE, copies them to a Gotek, and makes TurboView floppies to look things up on a real Amiga. A revival of TurboCAT and TurboCAT-Pro (1994-1996).
